steps.name: Third: organize goals and initiatives on the Star Chart
steps.done_when: For a new mother ship, start in Star Chart with Aladdin as default steward; choose a dev-drive storage directory when available or another location, brainstorm major goals and their initiatives/deliverables, identify source material, and require at least one goal/initiative before previewing populated Star Chart and Cave. Existing-host clients reuse its organization.

steps.name: First: choose or connect to the mother ship
steps.done_when: On first launch choose this computer as the personal mother ship or connect to an existing personal host through a guided Tailscale and secure pairing-token flow. Install Anchor and Foundry skills only on a new mother ship; client devices use that host.

steps.name: Provider capacity, cost and model controls
steps.done_when: Build and integrate the accepted Refinement 2 provider surface: reuse existing mother-ship sign-ins, native terminal-independent login, separately named subscription/API connections and account-qualified usage/allowance where supported. Preserve warning/full-strength policy. Integrate Cave gear/sidebar and verify usable live behavior before human review; no slice close inferred.

steps.name: Review Setup before laptop integration
steps.done_when: Refinement 2 starting layout is explicitly accepted in turn d7dd98a2-97a2-42f9-9273-c71b3e49cbf9. Review the working provider integration on the laptop after build and activation; preserve independent feedback and require explicit slice close.

steps.name: Test providers in the running laptop Anchor
steps.done_when: After the authorized integration lands and can be safely activated without interrupting sessions, test in John's existing laptop Anchor client: native sign-ins without open terminals, separate accounts, direct login, real or explicitly unsupported/stale allowance, Cave gear/settings and quality controls. Worktree browser checks do not establish delivery.

steps.name: Second: connect subscriptions and optional API keys
steps.done_when: Reuse existing host-side native sign-ins; provide normal native login from Setup without keeping terminals open. Preserve existing default accounts/sessions, isolate additional subscriptions where supported, and support explicit API connections without silent billing substitution.

steps.name: Wire Cave controls and reopen Setup
steps.done_when: In the authorized provider integration, wire the approved far upper-left Setup gear and bottom-left provider/account/model/reasoning controls to the same saved host settings. Keep capacity separately right, preserve Cave dialogue/drafts/navigation, and verify on the actual laptop after safe activation.

steps.name: Optional: connect calendars and email
steps.done_when: After provider setup, expose a separate optional calendars/email button for Outlook and Gmail. Secure sign-in and integration run on the mother ship; this does not block independent personal-host or goal organization work.

steps.name: Backups and restore
steps.done_when: Set up backups from the chosen project mapping and main directory.
